name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Jig goes with exactly one of Mabel, Maggot, or Shrimp.
Between Dale and Esther, one goes with Jig and the other with Wobbler.
Wobbler goes with none of Dale, Cricket, or Maggot.
Popper goes with exactly one of Mabel, Cricket, or Maggot.
Exactly one of these is true: Mabel goes with Minnow; Spinnerbait goes with Nightcrawler; Wobbler goes with Maggot.
Either Esther goes with Maggot, or Gus goes with Nightcrawler — but not both.
